away.summary: The Rangers (1-1-0) are coming off a 5-1 win against the Tampa Bay Lightning and did not hold a morning skate. They are projected to start Igor Shesterkin in goal with Dylan Garand as backup. The lineup features several recent acquisitions including Oliver Bjorkstrand, Pavel Dorofeyev, Eeli Tolvanen, Joseph Veleno, Sean Durzi, Marcus Pettersson, and Alberts Smits, who made his NHL debut in the season opener.

out.detail: Injured (upper body) - will miss first two games

returning: : Anton Johansson will make his NHL debut.
home.summary: The Red Wings (0-0-0) are projected to start John Gibson in goal with Daniil Tarasov as backup. Dylan Larkin (upper body) and Jacob Bernard-Docker (upper body) are injured and will miss the game, with Larkin expected to miss the first two games. Anton Johansson is expected to make his NHL debut. The team is hoping Larkin can return against the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday.
